name: Sign Rank / Spherical Dimension (affine)
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+1$.
proof: Theorem 12 states the source chain $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+1\leq\mathrm{SCO}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)$.  The paper explicitly identifies its sign-rank with the minimum real rank realizing the incidence sign matrix, which is the catalogue convention.
witness_verification: For the singleton-plus-empty class (with $n\geq4$), sign rank is 3 and spherical dimension is 1.
